Hello Helium D.,

I’m following up again regarding my MiniNerd replacement RMA for the defective power supply.

FedEx tracking ···· confirms the returned unit was delivered to you on September 11, 2026.

It’s now been over six weeks, and I still haven’t received an update on my replacement.

Could you please provide the current status and an estimated shipping date for the replacement unit?

If the newer ventilated/fan-cooled MiniNerd replacement is not available, I would be happy to proceed with the Magic Miner 40T instead.

Thank you,

Scott H.

(email hidden)

(phone hidden)
Handed to the team · RMA approval tag missing, replacement blocked, six weeks past arrival

Hi Scott,

Thank you for following up, and I'm sorry. Your NerdOctaxe reached our Chattanooga warehouse on September 14 and you have been waiting ever since with nothing back from us. Six weeks is far too long and that is on us, not on you.

Here is where it stands. The NerdOctaxe is out of stock and no new units are coming in, including the ventilated version, so we cannot send you the same miner. Two things we can do instead.

First, a Hammer Thor P2 (10 TH/s, $379), in stock at our US warehouse and shipping within two business days of your go-ahead. That is the fastest way to get a miner back on your bench.

Second, the Magic Miner 40T (40 TH/s, $799) that you mentioned. It is a pre-order that ships by December 14, 2026, and because it is a step up from the $499 you paid, there would be a $300 difference to pay. You can follow that batch on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status.

You said you would be happy with the 40T, so just reply with which of the two you want and I will set it up. A colleague is picking your case up today to sign off the replacement either way, so nothing is waiting on you except that choice.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for the update on my RMA and the replacement order (Shop····).

Before shipping the Hammer Thor P2 (10 TH/s), I would like to explore upgrading to the Magic Miner 40T instead.

I previously requested this option through both email and your online chat system.

Would you please provide the total cost to upgrade to the Magic Miner 40T, applying both the value of my returned NerdOctaxe and the $110.28 store credit toward the purchase?

Specifically, I would like to know how much additional money I would owe to make this exchange, along with the ETA. Im guess around 310.00 + tax or so. If this is close I would like to go this way.

Please hold shipment of the Hammer Thor P2 until we can confirm whether this upgrade is possible.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your response.

Scott H.

Hi Scott,

Your maths is right, and the upgrade is possible. Here are the exact numbers.

The Magic Miner 40T is $799.00. Against that we put the $379.00 value of the Thor P2 replacement and the $110.28 store credit already sitting on your account, which is $489.28, the full value of your original order. That leaves $309.72 plus tax for you to pay. On timing, the 40T is not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by December 14, 2026. You can follow that batch on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status.

One thing I have to be straight with you about. I could not hold the Thor P2. It was packed and labelled at our Chattanooga warehouse and left yesterday, tracking ····, due with you around November 3. So for the upgrade to work on those numbers, the Thor P2 needs to come back to us, ideally unopened. We cover the return shipping and you will get a prepaid label with the reference to write on the box.

If that suits you, just reply yes and a colleague is picking this up today to send the return label and the invoice for the $309.72 plus tax. If you would rather keep the Thor P2 and still add a 40T later, your $110.28 credit stays on your account and applies at checkout.

Sorry again for how long the first part of this took.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello Sarah and Team,

I received the Hammer Thor P2 (Order Shop····), but I still have not received a response to my previous requests regarding upgrading to the Magic Miner T40 instead.

I appreciate your efforts to resolve my original NerdOctaxe RMA. However, the Thor P2 is not the replacement I wanted, and I had specifically requested upgrade pricing through both email and your chat system before it was shipped.

I would like to resolve this by returning the Thor P2 unopened for its full listed value and applying that amount, along with my existing store credit, toward the T40.

Based on your shipping confirmation and the current advertised T40 price, here is my proposed exchange calculation:

Description A.
Magic Miner T40	$799.00
Full Thor P2 return value (Order Shop····)	−$379.00
Existing RMA store credit	−$110.28
Additional amount I would pay	$309.72
I believe $309.72 is a fair upgrade cost based on the values documented in your correspondence.

My proposal is simple: Please reserve a T40 for me, allow me to keep the Thor P2 unopened until the T40 becomes available, and provide a prepaid return shipping label. Once the exchange is arranged, I will return the Thor and pay the $309.72 difference, subject to your confirmation of the pricing.

Could you please confirm that you can approve this arrangement, along with the expected availability and shipping ETA for the T40?

This RMA has been ongoing since September, and I believe there has simply been a communication breakdown regarding my upgrade request. I would like to get this resolved in a way that works for both of us.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your confirmation.

Best regards,

Scott H.
Precision Software Tactics LLC
(email hidden) <mailto:(email hidden)>

Hi Scott,

Your figures are right, and the arrangement you proposed is the one we will do. The Magic Miner 40T is $799.00, your unopened Thor P2 comes back at its full $379.00, your $110.28 store credit applies on top, and that leaves $309.72 plus tax for you to pay. Nothing in that changes.

On timing, the 40T is not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by December 14, 2026. You can watch that batch on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status.

So please keep the Thor P2 sealed as you suggested. Your return reference is Shop····, and it goes back on a prepaid label at our cost, UPS Ground to our Chattanooga warehouse, so there is nothing for you to pay on the shipping. Write that reference on the outside of the box when you send it.

Two things are being set up for you now: the prepaid label itself and the 40T reserved against your order with the invoice for the $309.72 plus tax. A colleague picks this up today at 10am Eastern and you will get both by email, so you do not need to chase it again.

I am sorry your upgrade request did not reach the warehouse before the Thor P2 went out. That part was on us, and it is why none of the value is being lost here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thank you for the update. I appreciate you passing this along to the team. I will wait for them to follow up with the details directly. Please let me know if you need anything else from my end in the meantime.

Thank you
Scott H.
